repos_data.description: M-Courtyard: Local AI Model Fine-tuning Assistant for Apple Silicon. Zero-code, zero-cloud, privacy-first desktop app powered by Tauri + React + mlx-lm.

A speech-to-text system you can train for $25. A frozen speech encoder and a Qwen LLM joined by a small trained projector, with word timestamps, speaker diarization, a batched HTTP server, a live demo, and a free course.
Open source gateway bridging Meshtastic LoRa, Iridium satellite, cellular SMS, APRS and TAK over a Reticulum routing layer. Keeps people connected when the network is not. Runs on a   Raspberry Pi.
CLI & MCP server for Tuning Engines — fine-tune LLMs on code repositories

Two Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for self-hosted, local AI: manage and train Ollama/vLLM models, and route questions and tasks to local LLMs through Claude, ChatGPT or local models. Use the compute of your existing hardware, and let the models tap data on your machines when you wire them in.
